revisionDesc.change: Submit - Corrected error in papyri.info transcription (l.3, τἀργύριον), as noted by my student A. Salamoura.

Vote - AcceptText - ἡμῖν is the better reading. Were one to read συν there would be an unaccounted trace of ink between the Ny of ἡμῖν and the Sigma. The form of the Upsilon is unconvincing. With thanks to B. Kramer, who also looked at the reading and made it clear the ἡμῖν is undoubtedly correct.

Vote - AcceptText - Accept. ἡμῖν is clear to my eye; the black and white image is clearer on this point: http://ipap.csad.ox.ac.uk/PCZ-bw/300dpi/P.Cair.Zen.I.59077r.jpg; I think we must incorporate Clarysse's correction. --> <:οὐθὲν ἡμῖν πεποιηκότα=PN W. G. Claytor (digital image)||ed||οὐθὲν συνπεποιηκότα=W. Clarysse, Pap.Lugd.Bat. 21a p.101 (based on P.Cair.Zen. 1 plate 18)|οὐθὲν πεποιηκότα=Original edition:> :>

added ἡμῖν, l. 1. Cf. same word, l. 3. The left hasta of the mu is effaced. Do we wish also to record Clarysse's reading (P.L.Bat. XXI a, p. 101) from the plate of συνπεποιηκότα (printed in C.Ptol.Sklav. 18)?
